notes.title: Keyart Update
notes.notes:
Dear Community, 

"The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" is an artistic game and we didn't think the old key art was complementing the game in any way. We decided to recreate the game's art in which it represents it more and gives the player a better vision of what the game is about by just looking at it. 

We would also love to hear from you back about your thoughts of the new art.
